question: Is ultrasound equal to X-ray in pediatric fracture diagnosis?
reference_answer: Yes. Ultrasound not only has comparable sensitivity to that of X-ray for the identification of limb fractures but is also equally effective for the diagnosis of fracture type and dislocation. Thus, ultrasound can be used as an adequate alternative method to X-ray for pediatric fracture diagnosis.
